item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.77

Released on 2026-11-21.

CLI messages now show control characters as plain text. An undo in Studio never deletes a file another page still uses, and big root previews no longer hold up other requests.

Features

  • Studio Server: A host can name paths its project history never records (9bea44695, #8224).

Fixes

  • Core: Look up SVG selector aliases by namespace before matching their values (c8c5214a4, #8354).
  • CI: A diff is a release only when it bumps versions (de63e9731, #8355).
  • CLI: Show control characters as text in four more commands' printed lines (a744f5c3f, #8346).
  • CLI: Show control characters as text in cloudrun and cloud printed lines (af0664c8f, #8350).
  • CLI: Show control characters as text in the lambda commands' printed lines (eaec4f4ad, #8348).
  • CLI: Show control characters as text in sign-in, account status and preview lines (7a91dc9fe, #8347).
  • CLI: Show control characters in more command messages as text (9937baee1, #8344).
  • CLI: Show control characters in service reply messages as text (efd04c3b8, #8345).
  • Core: Remember each minted svg id's next free suffix (990aec78b, #8285).
  • Studio Server: An undo never deletes a file a page it leaves still names (7df3ae0a5, #8186).

Performance

  • Studio Server: A root preview's parse passes run off the request thread (e1b951586, #7934).

Docs & Examples

  • Release: List the Layers panel undo fix in the v0.9.75 notes (4095b7368, #8351).

item.title: v0.9.74
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.74

Released on 2026-11-21.

Films whose later scene sets an !important background on an id no longer render blank. Clips dropped on a sealed preview show on the timeline, and a package that fails to publish is tried again.

Features

  • Core: A sealed preview's frame runs an in-place text editing session for Studio (9848647b9, #8181).

Fixes

  • Producer: Count composition ids once for nested hosts, and charge the entry page's elements (acdf9e59b, #8335).
  • Ci: A package that fails to publish is tried again before the release fails (55cfbe008, #8333).
  • Core: Keep a later scene's id-selected !important layer hidden before it starts (861046f50, #8331).
  • Producer: A compile's downloads stop when the compile returns, however it ends (1ce69fd81, #8321).
  • Studio: A clip dropped on a sealed preview shows on the timeline (ca91e800e, #8330).
  • Skills: Agents run the CLI through the launcher, never a project's scripts (b2c18a45c, #8326).
  • Media Use: Media writes replace a link at the output name instead of following it (9e3fb696c, #8324).
  • CLI: A model name that every object carries is an unknown model (2ed4a141e, #8319).
  • Share: Hold an unprompted share in a received folder to the review it read (0012c1cb8, #8322).
  • Producer: Pass the render's cancel to probes of a source read at its URL (f8c90591b, #8312).

Internal

  • Engine: The egress proxy test makes its certificate in-process, not with openssl (cc453b767, #8296).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.73
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.73

Released on 2026-11-20.

Preview copies of long clips with sound finish again, so their footage no longer shows black. Saving history on a drive that stops answering no longer freezes the app, and sealed films show when their timeline arrives late.

Fixes

  • Studio: Paste refuses an element with an event handler or a script link (7b2c6dc1a, #8298).
  • Studio: The first edit of a film without ids no longer reloads the preview (99fcdfb5c, #8274).
  • Producer: Reserve each font's inline size before reading it (8ad346357, #8302).
  • Producer: Refuse a render whose mounts copy more than 100,000 elements (31959db98, #8295).
  • Studio: A timing drag moves the animation in place in a sealed preview (6cf81c668, #8163).
  • Media Use: Never write recipe files through links (be3d21807, #8257).
  • Studio: A host can own the live preview's load deadline, so a slow sealed film isn't an error (44d805c44, #8206).
  • Producer: Download at most 1,000 remote assets per compile, 8 at a time (c50ec09d2, #8290).
  • Producer: Pass the render's cancel to the compile's media, image and font downloads (edd1c90a4, #8289).
  • Share: A first share only lands on a review it created (1d5403525, #8282).
  • Core: Stop audio automation from crashing the preview renderer (e3896cf08, #8299).
  • Producer: A remote font embeds in the page instead of warning it is missing (2f23fbd36, #8297).
  • Studio Server: Saving history on a drive that stops answering no longer freezes the app (88c22a77f, #8294).
  • Player: A sealed film shows when its timeline arrives after the 8 s check (58de4c783, #8293).
  • Studio: A sealed audio group's undo reads the frame's reply only in its shape (3c735ad01, #8291).
  • CLI: Preview answers unknown paths with an inert refusal, not the Studio shell (4e3c96045, #8161).
  • Studio: A sealed resize of a layer whose GSAP keyframes animate its width saves (9b7be276a, #8288).
  • Studio: A sealed move, resize or turn takes GSAP's route when GSAP animates the layer (468ab907e, #8286).
  • Studio: A sealed resize, move or turn typed or made by the agent shows in the preview (89edb0af0, #8283).
  • Studio: Agent tools see the film in a sealed preview (c34df57ab, #8281).
  • Studio: A sealed crop lands where it was dragged (a755e3f58, #8279).
  • Core: A sub-composition's script re-run keeps the preview at its playhead (332720972, #8276).
  • Core: A redo in a sealed preview puts Studio's edit marks back in place (95a8a91b5, #8264).
  • Core: Split a rule's selector list once when rewriting svg id references (fbbbfe058, #8275).
  • Studio Server: Preview copies of long clips with sound finish again (07928702f, #8253).
  • Media Use: Remove only the temp folders media-use made, and never fail on cleanup (e16c681dc, #8267).
  • Core: Check svg id scopes against excluded roots in one ancestor walk (026bff07d, #8273).
  • Share: Ask before sharing from Studio and bind each action to the confirmed review (2c3427089, #8268).
  • Studio: A video with no size of its own keeps its file's size while a lighter copy plays (ce0932e04, #8233).
  • Studio: A sealed preview turns a rotated element live and saves the turn on its own route (fdc7d676c, #8271).
  • Studio: A sealed undo or redo of a keyframe edit re-runs in place instead of reloading (4fd96e353, #8272).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's timeline names each file by its project path (a8884522f, #8213).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's failed reload says only what the preview reported (f13969f13, #8194).
  • Engine: Bound the seek-index rebuild's temp copy (fab75fb91, #8269).

Docs & Examples

  • Render: Name the 100,000-element limit beside the mount limits (d6411daac, #8309).

Internal

  • Studio: A test chrome launch that fails with a non-error names what it holds (0ecb6671f, #8305).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.72
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.72

Released on 2026-11-20.

Renders limited by a CPU quota, such as a Kubernetes CPU limit, get their workers back, so long renders run at full speed again. Sealed previews restack layers from the layers panel and the timeline, and their videos keep colour grading and audio effects.

Fixes

  • Engine: Renders under a CPU quota get their workers back (db5950c00, #8262).
  • Studio: Dragging a layer in a sealed preview's layers panel restacks it (9c3bfe150, #8209).
  • Core: A sealed preview's own videos load with CORS, so colour grading and audio effects work (7b3eda190, #8189).
  • CLI: Describe the sign-in return test in plain words (c28cda322, #8259).
  • Media Use: Escape audio engine summary and broken audio_meta.json errors (4a11e46c7, #8258).
  • Studio: Save the stacking reorder of a timeline drag in a sealed preview (9dd8be3ac, #8167).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Give the 9:16 safe band that check enforces (bcb2dd031, #8261).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.71
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.71

Released on 2026-11-19.

Cancelling a render now stops its compile, and files a compile downloads have a size cap and one shared deadline. Renders read frames from MP4s whose seek index leaves out the first keyframe, and SVG-heavy compositions stay within the compile size limit.

Fixes

  • Engine: Extract frames from MP4s whose seek index leaves out the first keyframe (9813a6cbe, #8252).
  • Media Use: Duck, cut, transcribe, dither and audio scripts print control characters as escapes (98f548447, #8235).
  • Core: Attribute-value escapes write '<' so style text can't end early (9e7835367, #8250).
  • Media Use: Provider error lines print control characters as escapes (77134c927, #8249).
  • Core: Keep SVG selector alias growth within the compile budget (6bd0b5d87, #8238).
  • Lint: Read a media window's start through the parser (a7d7a6075, #8133).
  • Producer: Cancelling a render stops its compile (765883195, #8242).
  • Producer: Cap compile-time remote downloads, give them one deadline and stop them on cancel (77ea9d80c, #8195).
  • Core: Stop crashing on SVG elements named template (d106f9c8c, #8241).
  • Core: Read selector aliases only from what the compiler wrote (def770ed9, #8240).
  • Core: Page runtimes carry no wide characters, so pages stay one byte a char (01a5e948b, #8239).
  • Media Use: Re-freezing a recipe archives only under an integer version (e383abf47, #8201).

Docs & Examples

  • Adopters: Add ViralMint (78d8ad037, #7738).

Catalog

  • CLI: Report an empty catalog --type= as a usage error (c2911adc8, #8130).

Internal

  • CLI: The phone-clip offload tests pass when run together (3f3a6205a, #8071).

Full changelog

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.70

Released on 2026-11-19.

Projects with many SVG references or large sets of variables compile faster, and files whose path holds a tab join again. A provider key in your own project's .env file is used again, as the docs describe.

Fixes

  • Media Use: Recipe, prefs and SFX lines show control characters as escapes (36b60d18b4, #8202).
  • Render: Keep segment checkpoints in the local cache (e5283f63b9, #8137).
  • Skills: Raise the launcher minimum to 0.9.68 (a4995e9e6f, #8232).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's timeline shows its text clips' words and look (1cf98cf892, #8228).
  • Parsers: Join files whose path holds a tab again (4abbdc3e0d, #8227).
  • Compiler: Compiling a composition's variables stays fast as the input grows (12b83e9283, #8226).
  • Engine: Files whose path holds a line break are not joined (089e5f6b49, #8219).
  • Producer: Raise the sub-composition expansion limit to 64 MB (4d17b71b4d, #8096).
  • Studio: A sealed preview shows its loading overlay while media still loads (81f89b8150, #8184).
  • CLI: A provider key in your own or a cloned project's .env is used again. Only a project someone sent you gives way to your own key (8ace95ce94, #8099).

Performance

  • Core: Rewriting SVG attribute selectors stays fast with many references (c672ef0e5d, #8216).

Internal

  • Producer: Size the expansion-limit tests from the limit constant (4be5ba2aad, #8223).

Full changelog

HyperFrames v0.9.59

Released on 2026-11-16.

The preview player gets a fullscreen button, and a failed render now says why. Renders, Studio and the CLI keep to the project's own files and to public media hosts.

Features

  • CLI: Diff --hide scores a project's layer by what it adds (e6d5c699b, #7972).
  • Player: Add a fullscreen button to the preview player (5be6c1580, #7726).
  • Core: Describe replies carry the picker's element label, and studio exports standInHandle (51ae92510, #7936).

Fixes

  • Hidden and credential files stay out of Studio, history and lint (c68c78445, #7979).
  • Core: A page marked for another site gives that site only playback (c4d607c7f, #7980).
  • Studio Server: No write route touches files other tools run or trust (2a28e4368, #7964).
  • CLI: The skills update check never reads a project's git config (e368db138, #7975).
  • Lint: Run Studio and producer lint off the host's own thread (778a00564, #7974).
  • Producer: Probe sub-composition media defaults (95e4e7f88, #7550).
  • CLI: Validate and keyframes print project text with control characters as visible escapes (ce8d55d30, #7958).
  • Check: A media source that failed to load is not reported as a timeout (5e0c3db12, #7954).
  • CLI: Help shows each option's default once (d7f8d77fb, #7953).
  • CLI: Render --json gives each missing tool, a held slot and an old Node its own code (47d007e5b, #7842).
  • Sdk Playground: The Vite config loads on Node 22 before 22.18 (c7876f333, #7805).
  • Check: Mark a contrast finding by its severity and quote its text (ec5a4e2a1, #7752).
  • Player: The fix for the preview freezing when many clips share one long recording is pulled from this release, because it stopped an app embedding the preview from showing an edit (42508c1ef, #7795; reverted by 33e1a36a3, #7978).
  • Snapshot skips private files, no text-art demuxers, escaped warning text (8959deb00, #7943).
  • CLI: Capture names its local page server's port in the bypass entry (a9b0371c8, #7965).
  • CLI: A render that fails says why, even on a crash or a silent exit (2623ded13, #7957).
  • Studio: A long audio file from outside the project is never decoded for its waveform (c77cd301c, #7961).
  • Publish: Upload only what npm reads as checked; tags publish only main, next or alpha commits (5f4637977, #7959).
  • Engine: Media URL reads reach only public hosts under a restricted page network (994fbbde2, #7946).
  • Cli,engine: Pin the page server's direct host to an explicit port and the Studio's own origin (dbc9c1826, #7945).
  • Producer: A render waiting on a long audio mix says it is processing audio (df698a029, #7952).
  • Core: A capture page loads a clip with no set length only when it is due (9e5048772, #7938).
  • Studio: Beat analysis never picks a recording longer than a song (87955b890, #7944).
  • CLI: Own render-slot lock dir; refuse cache files other accounts can write (071a2da0b, #7951).
  • CLI: Never write project records through symlinks under .hyperframes (061ff5bbb, #7950).

Docs & Examples

  • Changelog: Weekly digest 2026-11-09-2026-11-16 (af873924d, #7969).
  • Publish: Say publishing waits for no approval and only admins push prerelease tags (a707e4737, #7960).

Catalog

  • CLI: Escape control characters in project, page and registry text (6f88be394, #7913).
  • Mcp: Run the MCP registry publish in the mcp-registry environment (45ff3526c, #7966).
  • Ci: A catalog publish run that main overtook ends clean instead of failing (77e675574, #7816).

Other Changes

HyperFrames v0.9.56

Released on 2026-11-16.

  • Studio: Present decks open only in their own site, and the preview reads only its own frame's messages (4067efc45, #7877).
  • Core: The runtime bridge checks each control message before acting on it (97d8f26e7, #7892).
  • CLI: render --docker keeps the host's page-network restriction inside the container (5d8605eb8, #7890).
  • CLI: preview --stop stops only the process the system reports holding the port (ace8a78dc, #7882).
  • CLI: The check cache is saved only as a project record, never through a linked file (7801e3ff3, #7884).
  • CLI: History turn ids read from the project folder are checked and sent encoded (6efa6b635, #7883).
  • CLI: Catch-up lists only the turns the app added after the hand-off (0f23f40f8, #7874).
  • CLI: A received-files record in a folder under the project counts for a render (1c159c550, #7900).

  • Engine: A cached browser is used only when its files match the pinned build (56a2d0c53, #7865).
  • Engine: Timeline frame predictions stay within the render's frames (f5a74a567, #7885).

  • CI: Publishing workflows run only for main (7bd6b9daf, #7875).

item.title: v0.9.37
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.37

Released on 2026-11-12.

Sharing refuses to build an archive when it can't read .hyperframesignore, so ignored files stay out. templates pull also refuses archives that hold links.

Fixes

  • CLI: hyperframes templates pull refuses an archive that holds anything other than plain files and folders, such as a symlink, hard link or device entry. Nothing is unpacked, and no partial folder is left behind. A link inside a pulled template could otherwise let preview, render and publish reach files elsewhere on your machine (ab66e5bd7, #7576).
  • Share: snapshotProject and snapshotFiles throw invalid_source_ignore again when .hyperframesignore can't be read. In 0.9.35 they skipped the unreadable file, so an archive built from the snapshot could include files the ignore file meant to leave out. Hosts that use these functions only for change detection should pass { lenientIgnore: true } to keep the 0.9.35 behavior. projectFingerprint already does (35cf03cab, #7573).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.35

Released on 2026-11-11.

Private files like .env and git data stay out of preview bundles, and local sharing only answers your own machine. Sharing also keeps tracking changes when .hyperframesignore uses gitignore patterns.

  • Studio App: The brand kits page says kits are shared with your workspace only (c218b37a3, #7570).

  • Core: The preview runtime offers its parent a typed message port. This prepares Studio for a sealed preview frame and changes nothing yet (ef5cdeb0a, #7556).

Performance

  • Docs: Load showcase film tiles only when they are near the screen (fd0c2337c, #7507).

Released on 2026-11-10.

Undo no longer loses work caught in the middle of a save, and the CLI shows the credits an image actually cost. Fewer renders are wrongly refused as too slow, and every frame of a video clip shows its own source frame.

  • CLI: Label GPT image prices as estimates and show the charged credits (0ba894123, #7351).

  • Producer: Refuse a too-slow render only when its typical frame says it cannot finish (88db83092, #7479).
  • Engine: A video clip shows a new source frame on every frame it is on screen (235c80bae, #7471).

  • Studio App: The Reference read is paid by Pro or a saved HeyGen API key (b12365d67, #7440).

  • Engine: Split the frame extractor tests so each file stays under the flake gate budget (1a758fd60, #7476).
